Production & Quality

From the fundamentals of manufacturing
to the standards of quality.

Our manufacturing operations are based in two production buildings in Yeongju.

Manufacturing sitesManufacturing processQuality inspectionQuality & environmental certifications

Manufacturing sites in Yeongju

Site-A and Site-B serve different product families.

Site-A

2018

TRB cage production

Built in 2018, Site-A established our manufacturing base in Yeongju with the relocation of part of the TRB cage production line from Incheon.

Site-B

2021

DGBB cage & shield production

Built in 2021, Site-B produces DGBB cages and shields. All production lines were relocated to Yeongju that same year.

Production floor

From materials and tooling
to finished components.

From material storage to cage forming.
A look inside Samho Engineering’s manufacturing facilities.

Manufacturing process

One-punch tooling was introduced for TRB cage production in 2011. Our experience in stamped components continues in the manufacturing of bearing components.

Key equipment

We operate tooling and equipment for cage forming, with manufacturing facilities tailored to each product family.

Quality inspection

Inspecting the component.
Verified through measurement.

Inspection work and measuring equipment.
A look at how we verify quality.

Inspection criteria

Drawing dimensions, specifications and application conditions provide the starting point for quality. Product-specific inspection criteria are defined through review of the requirements.

Inspection equipment

Measuring equipment in our inspection room is used to check product dimensions and geometry.

Quality management procedure

We reflect requirements in manufacturing and inspection, and communicate clearly with customers whenever clarification is needed.
